$schema_note: Dismissal registry for the Python dependency audit (mirrors frontend/.npm-audit-exemptions.json and .trivyignore doctrine: every entry carries a REVIEW BY date; scripts/check-pip-audit-exemptions.py fails CI if any date passes, if any pip-audit finding is not covered here, if an exemption stops matching a finding, or if the advisory pip-audit reports carries a fix_versions entry (the sanctioned premise is 'no upstream fix exists' - a released fix ends the exemption, take the bump). The gate IS this checker; a bare `pip-audit --ignore-vuln CVE-…` (the shape this replaced) fails OPEN in both directions: the flag suppresses the finding forever with no expiry, and a stale ignore suppresses nothing so nobody notices it rotting. O1.8 emptied this registry by measurement, not by deletion-without-cause: CVE-2026-0994 (protobuf json_format.ParseDict DoS, added 91a841507, review date 2026-01-23) no longer reproduces - the lock resolves protobuf 7.36.1 and pip-audit 2.10.1 reports ZERO findings without the flag (measured on the O1.8 branch; OSV CVE-2026-0994 last_affected = 33.4). If protobuf ever regresses below the fix line, the advisory comes back RED and lands here with a reason and an expiry.
